dependency_evidence.observation: Confirmed with Context7, official source URL, and the installed core: operations already queued on the worker thread can execute even when their waiting Future is cancelled.

limitations: Only temporary SQLite databases and ephemeral software Fernet keys were used. Native strike_rs IPC was blocked before imports; no Rekor/network, operator store/key, hardware service or ATTESTED object was used.
The actor is reviewed for one event loop at a time and sequential restart across loops, not concurrent cross-thread/cross-loop access.
Payload and vault configuration are captured when processing starts, not frozen at admission. A caller-cancelled reply can correspond to a committed accepted write.
stop waits for accepted SQLite processing to settle. Tests use explicit barriers and bounded waits; this is not a physical timeout, crash-durability or forced-I/O-interruption guarantee.
Idempotency covers persisted database row/result. Existing post-commit IPC broadcast may still occur for retries; exactly-once external delivery was neither claimed nor exercised.
Historical UUID, chain hashing/timestamp format, SQL schema and ignored agent_id persistence behavior remain outside migration scope. C0431 remains OPEN.

The independent pytest bootstrap imports the actual actor/dependency sources through a namespace package to avoid unrelated root-package initialization; broad package/distribution behavior is not certified.
Parent-reported related-suite and MyPy results are not represented as independently executed checks in this report.
